First Time Free Fentanyl
I got out of work around 10 pm. I went to a RED's house, who is a frequent user of opiates. In the past I've stayed away from opiates, due to not knowing how great they can be. Anyway, RED was wearing a 25 mcg Fentanyl patch, and asked if I wanted one. I'm not the type to turn down a free buzz, so I took it.
RED said to put it in my mouth and chew it, so that's what I did. 15 minutes later I was feeling more euphoric then I've ever felt in my life, up until then. Me and RED were playing video games for about 45 min. Then we decided to smoke a cig. I smoked three cigs in a row, which I never do. Cigs were so much better at the time. I was faded till I went to sleep around 2am. As soon as I woke up I puked in the toilet. It wasn't a bad puke at all though. Anyway I remember there were times when it was hard to breathe.
I remember there were times when it was hard to breathe.
If you start feeling that way you should go to the ER.
Its amazing how much my tolerance has increased over the next year. 25 mcg was a lot back in 2011. Now, not so much.
